args.command: echo '=== browser binaries ==='; for x in chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable brave-browser; do p=$(command -v "$x" 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$p" ] && echo "$x=$p"; done; echo '=== playwright ==='; /opt/node/bin/node -e "try{const p=require.resolve('playwright'); console.log('PLAYWRIGHT=YES '+p)}catch(e){console.log('PLAYWRIGHT=NO')}" 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== openclaw browser help ==='; /opt/node/bin/openclaw browser --help 2>&1 | head -60; echo '=== openclaw browser status ==='; /opt/node/bin/openclaw browser status 2>&1 | head -80 || true
